Exhibit 1 = Post-employment benefits Delta has provided two types of post-employment benefit plans for its
employees (members). Both plans are administered by separate legal entities.
Plan A provides the benefits for the majority of the employees of Delta. The contributions paid into Pian A are
invested to produce appropriate growth in the value of the plan. The ultimate level of post-employment benefits

Membership of plan B is restricted to the directors and other senior employees of Delta. The contributions paid into
Plan 8 are invested to make optimal returns. However, post-employment benefits payable to Plan B members are
based on the salary of the relevant employee at the date of their retirement and their length of service with Delta.
